 By: Election Desk

 Banswara Zilla Parishad Election Results 2026: There are 43 Wards in Banswara Banswara Zilla Parishad (ZP) Election Results 2026 LIVE Updates: Follow the Rajasthan Zilla Parishad and Panchayat Samiti election results from Banswara today on Indianexpress.com. Counting of votes for the Banswara Zilla Parishad election 2026 is set to begin soon. The Rajasthan State Election Commission will declare the results following the counting process. Voting for Zilla Parishad and Panchayat Samiti members was conducted in four phases across Rajasthan.
 The Banswara Zilla Parishad has 43 wards. Alongside this, the district has 15 Panchayat Samitis. Voters participated to elect representatives responsible for addressing local needs and supporting rural development at the district and block levels.
 Banswara Zilla Parishad Previous Election Results
 In the previous Zilla Parishad election, 31 wards are recorded for Banswara in the historical results. The INC emerged as the single-largest party by winning 20 seats, while the BJP secured 10 seats. The IND won 1 seats.

 Live Updates 
 Nov 20, 2026 09:46 AM IST
 Counting of votes underway. Watch video
 Counting of votes is underway across 37 districts. Here's a glimpse of it
 VIDEO | Rajasthan: The counting of votes for the Jodhpur Panchayat Samiti and Zila Parishad member elections began at 8:00 AM at the Polytechnic College. 
In Jodhpur district, elections were held for 43 Zila Parishad member seats and 351 Panchayat Samiti member seats across 23 Panchayat Samitis. In total, 394 public representatives will be elected. The counting will take place in two phases, the first phase from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM, and the second phase starting from 12:00 PM. 
(Full video available on PTI Videos - https://t.co/bIyFWTfmBd )
— Press Trust of India (@PTI_News) November 20, 2026 
 Nov 20, 2026 09:30 AM IST
 A battle between BJP and Congress: The key candidates
 The electoral contest, which is significant for both BJP and Congress, witnesses candidates from prominent political families in fray. 
 In Churu, former BJP MLA Rajendra Rathore's son Parakram Singh and daughter-in-law Kanika Singh are contesting Zila Parishad elections, along with Kanak Budania, wife of Congress MLA Narendra Budania.
 Urban Development and Housing minister Jhabar Singh Kharra's wife Shanti Devi and sons Ajay Singh and Durga Singh are contesting elections in Shrimadhopur panchayat samiti in Sikar.
 Other prominent candidates include Nikita Dudi, daughter-in-law of former Congress MP Rameshwar Dudi, in Bikaner; Amin Khan Fakir and Amardin Fakir, brothers of former Congress MLA and minister Saleh Mohammad, in Jaisalmer and Beena Bairwa, wife of Congress MLA D C Bairwa, in Dausa.

 As counting of votes is underway, the BJP has taken early lead in 20 Panchayat seats, Congress in 13, as per State Election Commission.

 Counting of votes begins
 Counting of votes has begun across 1,275 Zila Parishad and 7,543 Panchayat Samiti wards across 37 districts in Rajasthan.
 Nov 20, 2026 07:35 AM IST
 What matters for Rajasthan Panchayat elections ?
 In Rajasthan Panchayat elections, isssues such as water and roads, MGNREGA and employment, candidate’s personal image and local anti-incumbency matters. 
 Nov 20, 2026 07:28 AM IST
 Counting of votes for 37 districts to be held today
 The counting of votes will be held simultaneously for 37 districts in the district headquarters today while it will be conducted for the remaining Kota, Baran, Sri Ganganagar and Karauli districts on December 17, as per the State Election Commission’s order on November 18.
